heroHeadline: FIFA Sets May 20 Zurich Talks with Iran — Taj Escalates; New Ticket Batch Released; 4 Days to Provisional Squad Deadline
heroSubtitle: FIFA formally invited Iran Football Federation president Mehdi Taj to Zurich on May 20 for direct talks with Gianni Infantino — the last significant diplomatic window before the June 1 final squad submission deadline. Taj escalated on May 7, signaling a 'different decision' could come if FIFA cannot guarantee Iranian players and staff will not face 'politically motivated questioning' over IRGC links — a condition Secretary of State Rubio has categorically ruled out by barring all IRGC-linked personnel. Iran's preliminary squad list is due in 4 days (May 11); the final 26-man panel is due June 1. Iran Group G matches remain on the schedule at US venues (SoFi Stadium June 15, 21; Lumen Field June 26). Separately, FIFA released a new batch of 2026 World Cup tickets on May 7 at noon ET as resale prices showed modest declines from their peak; Infantino defended market pricing at the Milken Institute Global Conference. On the squad front: 4 days to the FIFA provisional squad deadline (May 11); France announces May 14; Brazil May 18 (Rodrygo confirmed out, Estevao in doubt); Germany May 21; USMNT roster revealed at a live NYC event on May 26 (FOX Sports). Messi is among 21 players Scaloni has confirmed in Argentina's plans. Hugo Ekitike (Achilles) is confirmed out for France. Gianluca Prestianni remains globally banned for two World Cup group matches (Argentina, May 6 FIFA ruling). 35 days to kickoff at Estadio Azteca.
